background-size: cover;
background-position: center 30%;
opacity: 0.22;
z-index: 0;
}
#app {
position: relative;
z-index: 1;
min-height: 100vh;
}
/* ---- PAGE SYSTEM ---- */
.page { display: none; }
.page.active { display: block; }
/* ---- HEADER ---- */
header {
background: rgba(27,45,36,0.92);
backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
padding: 16px 20px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: space-between;
position: sticky;
top: 0;
z-index: 100;
border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(82,183,136,0.2);
}
header h1 {
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 15px;
font-weight: 800;
color: #fff;
line-height: 1.3;
flex: 1;
}
header h1 .title-line1 { display: block; font-size: 17px; }
header h1 .title-line2 { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); font-weight: 600; }
header h1 span { color: var(--green-light); }
.header-btn {
background: rgba(82,183,136,0.15);
border: 1px solid rgba(82,183,136,0.3);
color: var(--green-light);
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 600;
padding: 8px 14px;
border-radius: 8px;
cursor: pointer;
transition: all 0.2s;
}
.header-btn:hover { background: rgba(82,183,136,0.25); }
/* ---- MAIN CONTENT ---- */
main { padding: 16px; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }
/* ---- DAY CARDS ---- */
.day-card {
background: var(--card);
border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
border-radius: var(--radius);
margin-bottom: 12px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: var(--shadow);
transition: transform 0.15s;
}
.day-card.today {
border: 2px solid var(--green-light);
box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(82,183,136,0.15), var(--shadow);
}
.day-header {
padding: 12px 16px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 10px;
border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.08);
background: rgba(216,243,220,0.4);
}
.day-card.today .day-header { background: rgba(82,183,136,0.15); }
.day-date {
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 800;
color: var(--green);
min-width: 70px;
}
.day-card.today .day-date { color: var(--green); }
.today-badge {
background: var(--green-light);
color: #fff;
font-size: 11px;
font-weight: 700;
padding: 3px 9px;
border-radius: 20px;
letter-spacing: 0.04em;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.day-progress {
margin-left: auto;
font-size: 12px;
color: var(--muted);
font-weight: 600;
}
.day-tasks { padding: 0; }
/* Sectie styling */
.dag-sectie { padding: 7px 12px; border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.08); }
.dag-sectie:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.dag-sectie.ochtend { background: rgba(251,191,36,0.07); border-left: 3px solid #f59e0b; }
.dag-sectie.avond { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.07); border-left: 3px solid #8b5cf6; }
.dag-sectie.water { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.06); border-left: 3px solid #3b82f6; }
.dag-sectie.thuistaken { background: rgba(107,114,128,0.05); border-left: 3px solid #9ca3af; }
.dag-sectie.vuilbak { background: rgba(249,115,22,0.05); border-left: 3px solid #f97316; }
.dag-sectie-label { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 5px; }
.taak-rij-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 5px; }
.taak-rij-1 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 5px; }
.taak-rij-auto { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; }
/* ---- TASK BUTTON ---- */
.task-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.task-label {
font-size: 11px;
font-weight: 600;
color: var(--muted);
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.task-btn {
padding: 6px 10px;
border-radius: 9px;
border: 0.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.15);
background: #fff;
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
font-size: 12px;
font-weight: 600;
color: var(--muted);
cursor: pointer;
text-align: left;
transition: all 0.18s;
width: 100%;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
align-items: flex-start;
gap: 2px;
min-height: 42px;
}
.taak-naam { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; opacity: 0.8; }
.taak-waarde { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.task-btn:hover { border-color: var(--green-light); background: var(--green-pale); color: var(--green); }
.task-btn.done { background: var(--green-pale); border-color: var(--green-light); }
.task-btn.done .taak-waarde { color: var(--green); }
.task-btn:hover { border-color: var(--green-light); background: var(--green-pale); }
.task-btn.disabled {
opacity: 0.3;
cursor: not-allowed;
pointer-events: none;
}
/* Vuilbak knoppen - altijd 4 op 1 rij, elk exact 25% */
.vuilbak-rij { display: flex; gap: 5px; width: 100%; }
.task-btn.vuilbak-entry, .vuilbak-leeg {
flex: 1 1 0;
min-width: 0;
}
.task-btn.vuilbak-entry {
flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
padding: 6px 2px; min-height: 50px; gap: 3px; text-align: center;
width: 0;
}
.task-btn.vuilbak-todo { border-color: rgba(45,106,79,0.15); background: #fff; }
.task-btn.vuilbak-done { background: var(--green-pale); border-color: var(--green-light); }
.vuilbak-bol { width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.vuilbak-type { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; }
.vuilbak-naam { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green); }
.vuilbak-leeg { min-height: 50px; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.03); border: 0.5px dashed rgba(0,0,0,0.08); width: 0; }
/* Opmerkingen */
.remarks-item { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.remarks-input {
width: 100%;
padding: 9px 12px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.2);
background: #fff;
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
color: var(--text);
resize: none;
min-height: 38px;
transition: border 0.2s;
outline: none;
}
.remarks-input:focus { border-color: var(--green-light); }
.remarks-readonly {
width: 100%;
padding: 9px 12px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.1);
background: rgba(45,106,79,0.04);
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
color: var(--text);
min-height: 38px;
line-height: 1.5;
}
/* Per-name colors - 6 distinct */
.task-btn.done.color-0 { background: #dbeafe; border-color: #3b82f6; }
.task-btn.done.color-0 .taak-waarde { color: #1d4ed8; }
.task-btn.done.color-1 { background: #dcfce7; border-color: #22c55e; }
.task-btn.done.color-1 .taak-waarde { color: #15803d; }
.task-btn.done.color-2 { background: #fef9c3; border-color: #eab308; }
.task-btn.done.color-2 .taak-waarde { color: #854d0e; }
.task-btn.done.color-3 { background: #ede9fe; border-color: #8b5cf6; }
.task-btn.done.color-3 .taak-waarde { color: #6d28d9; }
.task-btn.done.color-4 { background: #ffedd5; border-color: #f97316; }
.task-btn.done.color-4 .taak-waarde { color: #c2410c; }
.task-btn.done.color-5 { background: #ccfbf1; border-color: #14b8a6; }
.task-btn.done.color-5 .taak-waarde { color: #0f766e; }
/* Task emoji label */
.task-emoji { font-size: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
/* ---- POPUP OVERLAY ---- */
.popup-overlay {
display: none;
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
z-index: 500;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
padding: 20px;
}
.popup-overlay.open { display: flex; }
.popup {
background: #fff;
border-radius: 18px;
padding: 24px;
width: 100%;
max-width: 320px;
box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
animation: popIn 0.2s ease;
}
@keyframes popIn { from { transform: scale(0.92); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
.popup h3 {
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 800;
color: var(--text);
margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.popup p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.popup-names { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.popup-name-btn {
padding: 12px 16px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.2);
background: #f8fdf9;
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 15px;
font-weight: 700;
color: var(--green);
cursor: pointer;
text-align: left;
transition: all 0.15s;
}
.popup-name-btn:hover { background: var(--green-pale); border-color: var(--green-light); }
.popup-cancel {
margin-top: 12px;
width: 100%;
padding: 10px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: none;
background: transparent;
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
color: var(--muted);
cursor: pointer;
transition: color 0.15s;
}
.popup-cancel:hover { color: var(--amber); }
/* ---- SETTINGS PAGE ---- */
.settings-wrap { padding: 16px; max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; overflow-x: hidden; }
.settings-section {
background: var(--card);
border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
border-radius: var(--radius);
padding: 20px;
margin-bottom: 16px;
box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.settings-section h2 {
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 800;
color: var(--green);
margin-bottom: 16px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 8px;
}
.form-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.form-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block; }
.form-input {
width: 100%;
width: -webkit-fill-available;
max-width: 100%;
padding: 10px 12px;
border-radius: 9px;
border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.2);
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
font-size: 14px;
color: var(--text);
outline: none;
transition: border 0.2s;
background: #fff;
box-sizing: border-box;
display: block;
min-width: 0;
}
input[type="date"].form-input {
-webkit-appearance: none;
appearance: none;
width: 100%;
width: -webkit-fill-available;
min-width: 0;
}
.form-input:focus { border-color: var(--green-light); }
.name-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: center; }
.name-row input { flex: 1; }
.btn-remove {
padding: 8px 12px;
border-radius: 8px;
border: none;
background: #fee2e2;
color: #dc2626;
font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 600;
cursor: pointer;
flex-shrink: 0;
transition: background 0.15s;
}
.btn-remove:hover { background: #fca5a5; }
.btn-add {
width: 100%;
padding: 10px;
border-radius: 9px;
border: 1.5px dashed rgba(45,106,79,0.3);
background: transparent;
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 700;
color: var(--green);
cursor: pointer;
transition: all 0.15s;
margin-top: 4px;
}
.btn-add:hover { background: var(--green-pale); border-color: var(--green-light); }
.btn-save {
width: 100%;
padding: 14px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: none;
background: var(--green);
color: #fff;
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 15px;
font-weight: 800;
cursor: pointer;
transition: background 0.2s;
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.btn-save:hover { background: var(--green-light); }
.btn-back {
width: 100%;
padding: 12px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: 1.5px solid rgba(45,106,79,0.2);
background: transparent;
color: var(--muted);
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 14px;
font-weight: 700;
cursor: pointer;
transition: all 0.15s;
}
.btn-back:hover { background: var(--green-pale); color: var(--green); }
/* Days of week checkboxes */
.days-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
.day-check { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.day-check span { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.day-check input[type=checkbox] { width: 20px; height: 20px; accent-color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; }
/* Specific dates for vuilbak */
.date-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.date-tag {
background: #fdebd0;
color: var(--amber);
border: 1px solid var(--amber-light);
border-radius: 20px;
padding: 4px 10px;
font-size: 12px;
font-weight: 600;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 5px;
}
.date-tag.rest { background:#f3f4f6; color:#374151; border-color:#9ca3af; }
.date-tag.pmd { background:#dbeafe; color:#1d4ed8; border-color:#3b82f6; }
.date-tag.gft { background:#dcfce7; color:#15803d; border-color:#22c55e; }
.date-tag.papier{ background:#fef9c3; color:#854d0e; border-color:#ca8a04; }
.date-tag button { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; padding: 0; opacity:0.7; }
.date-tag button:hover { opacity:1; }
.date-add-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.date-add-row input { flex: 1; }
.btn-add-date {
padding: 10px 14px;
border-radius: 9px;
border: none;
background: var(--amber-light);
color: #fff;
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
font-size: 13px;
font-weight: 700;
cursor: pointer;
flex-shrink: 0;
transition: background 0.15s;
}
.btn-add-date:hover { background: var(--amber); }
/* Toggle switch */
.toggle-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 48px; height: 26px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.toggle-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }
.toggle-slider { position: absolute; cursor: pointer; inset: 0; background: #ccc; border-radius: 26px; transition: .3s; }
.toggle-slider:before { position: absolute; content: ""; height: 20px; width: 20px; left: 3px; bottom: 3px; background: white; border-radius: 50%; transition: .3s; }
input:checked + .toggle-slider { background: var(--green-light); }
input:checked + .toggle-slider:before { transform: translateX(22px); }
/* ---- LOG ---- */
.log-list { max-height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.log-entry {
display: flex;
gap: 10px;
align-items: flex-start;
padding: 8px 10px;
background: #f0faf3;
border-radius: 8px;
font-size: 12px;
}
.log-time { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; min-width: 95px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.log-text { color: var(--text); line-height: 1.4; }
.log-empty { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; padding: 16px 0; }
.btn-clear-log {
margin-top: 10px;
padding: 8px 14px;
border-radius: 8px;
border: 1px solid #fca5a5;
background: transparent;
color: #dc2626;
font-size: 12px;
font-weight: 600;
cursor: pointer;
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
transition: background 0.15s;
}
.btn-clear-log:hover { background: #fee2e2; }
/* ---- PASSWORD SCREEN ---- */
#pw-screen {
display: none;
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(27,45,36,0.97);
z-index: 400;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 16px;
}
#pw-screen.open { display: flex; }
#pw-screen h2 { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; }
#pw-screen p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size: 14px; }
#pw-input {
padding: 14px 18px;
border-radius: 12px;
border: 2px solid rgba(82,183,136,0.4);
background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
color: #fff;
font-size: 18px;
font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
text-align: center;
letter-spacing: 6px;
width: 200px;
outline: none;
transition: border 0.2s;
}
#pw-input:focus { border-color: var(--green-light); }
#pw-error { color: #f87171; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.btn-pw-cancel {
padding: 10px 20px;
border-radius: 10px;
border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
background: transparent;
color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
font-size: 14px;
cursor: pointer;
font-family: 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif;
transition: all 0.15s;
}
.btn-pw-cancel:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
/* Loading */
#loading {
position: fixed;
inset: 0;
background: rgba(27,45,36,0.95);
z-index: 600;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 16px;
}
.loader { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid rgba(82,183,136,0.2); border-top-color: var(--green-light); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
#loading p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-size: 14px; }
/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
header h1 { font-size: 15px; }
}
.paw { font-size: 20px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="bg-image"></div>
<div id="loading">
<div class="loader"></div>
<p>Balou's schema laden... 🐾</p>
</div>
<div id="pw-screen">
<span style="font-size:40px">🔐</span>
<h2>Instellingen</h2>
<p>Voer het wachtwoord in</p>
<input type="password" id="pw-input" placeholder="••••" maxlength="20">
<div id="pw-error" style="display:none">Verkeerd wachtwoord</div>
<button class="btn-pw-cancel" onclick="closePwScreen()">Annuleren</button>
</div>
<!-- NAAM POPUP -->
<div class="popup-overlay" id="name-popup">
<div class="popup">
<h3>Wie ben jij? 👋</h3>
<p id="popup-task-label">Selecteer je naam</p>
<div class="popup-names" id="popup-names-list"></div>
<button class="popup-cancel" onclick="closePopup()">Annuleren</button>
</div>
</div>
<div id="app">
<!-- HOOFDPAGINA -->
<div id="page-main" class="page active">
<header>
<h1 id="header-title"><span class="title-line1">Balou's <span>schema</span></span><span class="title-line2" id="header-period"></span></h1>
<button class="header-btn" onclick="openSettings()">⚙️ Instellingen</button>
</header>
<main id="schedule-container">
<p style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5); text-align:center; padding:40px 0; font-size:14px;">Laden...</p>
</main>
</div>
<!-- INSTELLINGEN -->
<div id="page-settings" class="page">
<header>
<h1>⚙️ <span>Instellingen</span></h1>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
<button class="header-btn" onclick="saveAndGoBack()">💾 Opslaan & terug</button>
<button class="header-btn" style="background:rgba(231,111,81,0.15);border-color:rgba(231,111,81,0.4);color:#e76f51;" onclick="resetAll()">🗑️ Reset</button>
</div>
</header>
<div class="settings-wrap">
<!-- Periode -->
<div class="settings-section">
<h2>📅 Periode</h2>
<div class="form-group" style="overflow:hidden;">
<label class="form-label">Start datum</label>
<div style="overflow:hidden;width:100%;">
<input type="date" id="s-start" class="form-input" onchange="onStartDateChange(this.value)">
</div>
</div>
<div class="form-group" style="overflow:hidden;">
<label class="form-label">Eind datum</label>
<div style="overflow:hidden;width:100%;">
<input type="date" id="s-end" class="form-input">
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Namen -->
<div class="settings-section">
<h2>👥 Namen</h2>
<div id="names-list"></div>
<button class="btn-add" onclick="addName()">+ Naam toevoegen</button>
</div>
<!-- Opmerkingen per dag -->
<div class="settings-section">
<h2>📝 Opmerkingen per dag</h2>
<div id="remarks-list">
<button class="btn-add" onclick="showRemarksFields()" style="margin-top:4px;">📝 Opmerkingen toevoegen / bewerken</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Vuilbak -->
<div class="settings-section">
<h2>🗑️ Vuilbak buiten — specifieke datums</h2>
<p style="font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:12px;">Op welke datums moet de vuilbak buiten gezet worden? Selecteer datum én type.</p>
<div class="date-tags" id="vuilbak-dates"></div>
<div class="date-add-row">
<input type="date" id="vuilbak-date-input" class="form-input">
<select id="vuilbak-type-input" class="form-input" style="max-width:130px;">
<option value="rest">⚫ Restafval</option>
<option value="pmd">🔵 PMD</option>
<option value="gft">🟢 GFT</option>
<option value="papier">🟡 Papier</option>
</select>
<button class="btn-add-date" onclick="addVuilbakDate()">+ Toevoegen</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Log -->
<div class="settings-section">
<h2>📋 Activiteitenlog</h2>
<div class="log-list" id="log-list">
<div class="log-empty">Nog geen activiteit geregistreerd</div>
</div>
<button class="btn-clear-log" onclick="clearLog()">🗑️ Log leegmaken</button>
</div>
<!-- Wachtwoord -->
<div class="settings-section">
<h2>🔐 Wachtwoordbeveiliging</h2>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;">
<p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;">Beveiliging instellingen</p>
<label class="toggle-switch">
<input type="checkbox" id="pw-toggle" onchange="togglePassword(this.checked)">
<span class="toggle-slider"></span>
</label>
</div>
<div id="pw-code-row" style="display:none;">
<label class="form-label">4-cijferig wachtwoord</label>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;">
<input type="number" id="pw-code-input" class="form-input" placeholder="0000" maxlength="4" min="0" max="9999" style="max-width:120px;letter-spacing:4px;font-size:18px;text-align:center;">
<button class="btn-add-date" onclick="savePassword()" style="flex-shrink:0;">Opslaan</button>
</div>
<p id="pw-saved-msg" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--green);margin-top:6px;display:none;">✓ Wachtwoord opgeslagen</p>
</div>
</div>
<button class="btn-save" onclick="saveAndGoBack()">💾 Opslaan & terug naar schema</button>
<button class="btn-back" onclick="goBack()">← Terug zonder opslaan</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<script type="module">

databaseURL: "https://balou-schema-default-rtdb.europe-west1.firebasedatabase.app",
projectId: "balou-schema",
storageBucket: "balou-schema.firebasestorage.app",
messagingSenderId: "119665652766",
appId: "1:119665652766:web:34c83d9330e531b624aa0f"
};
const fbApp = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = getDatabase(fbApp);
const PASSWORD_DEFAULT = "0000"; // fallback only
let passwordEnabled = false; // loaded from localStorage
let customPassword = "0000";
// State
let settings = {
startDate: null,
endDate: null,
names: [],
vuilbakDates: []
};
let schedule = {};
let logEntries = [];
let pendingTask = null; // { dateStr, taskKey, isVuilbak }
// ---- UTILS ----
function dateStr(d) {
return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
}
function formatDate(str) {
const [y, m, d] = str.split('-');
return `${d}/${m}/${String(y).slice(2)}`;
}
function formatDateLong(str) {
const days = ['Zondag','Maandag','Dinsdag','Woensdag','Donderdag','Vrijdag','Zaterdag'];
const months = ['jan','feb','mrt','apr','mei','jun','jul','aug','sep','okt','nov','dec'];
const d = new Date(str + 'T12:00:00');
return `${days[d.getDay()]} ${d.getDate()} ${months[d.getMonth()]}`;
}
function getDayOfWeek(str) {
return new Date(str + 'T12:00:00').getDay();
}
function today() { return dateStr(new Date()); }
const TASKS = [
{ key: 'ochtend', label: 'Wandeling', emoji: '🐾', always: true, sectie: 'ochtend' },
{ key: 'ontbijt', label: 'Ontbijt', emoji: '🦴', always: true, sectie: 'ochtend' },
{ key: 'avondwandeling',label: 'Wandeling', emoji: '🐾', always: true, sectie: 'avond' },
{ key: 'avondeten', label: 'Avondeten', emoji: '🦴', always: true, sectie: 'avond' },
{ key: 'drinkwater', label: 'Drinkwater', emoji: '💧', always: true, sectie: 'water' },
{ key: 'tuin', label: 'Tuin proper', emoji: '🌿', always: true, sectie: 'thuistaken' },
{ key: 'keuken', label: 'Keuken', emoji: '🧹', always: true, sectie: 'thuistaken' },
{ key: 'vuilbak', label: 'Vuilbak', emoji: '🗑️', always: false, sectie: 'vuilbak', type: 'vuilbak' },
];
const SECTIES = [
{ key: 'ochtend', label: 'Ochtend', cols: 2 },
{ key: 'avond', label: 'Avond', cols: 2 },
{ key: 'water', label: 'Alle dagen', cols: 1 },
{ key: 'thuistaken',label: 'Alle dagen', cols: 2, hideLabel: true },
{ key: 'vuilbak', label: 'Vuilbak buiten', cols: 'auto' },
];
// Map name -> color index (0-4), persistent per session
const nameColors = {};
function getNameColor(name) {
if (nameColors[name] === undefined) {
const idx = Object.keys(nameColors).length % 6;
nameColors[name] = idx;
}
return nameColors[name];
}
// ---- FIREBASE LOAD ----
async function loadAll() {
const stored = localStorage.getItem('balou_pw_enabled');
if (stored !== null) passwordEnabled = stored === 'true';
const storedPw = localStorage.getItem('balou_pw_code');
if (storedPw) customPassword = storedPw;
const [settSnap, schedSnap, logSnap] = await Promise.all([
get(ref(db, 'settings')),
get(ref(db, 'schedule')),
get(ref(db, 'log'))
]);
if (settSnap.exists()) {
const s = settSnap.val();
settings.startDate = s.startDate || null;
settings.endDate = s.endDate || null;
settings.names = s.names || [];
settings.vuilbakDates = s.vuilbakDates || [];
}
if (schedSnap.exists()) schedule = schedSnap.val();
if (logSnap.exists()) {
const raw = logSnap.val();
logEntries = Object.entries(raw).map(([k,v]) => ({ id: k, ...v })).sort((a,b) => b.ts - a.ts);
}
document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';
renderMain();
// Live updates
onValue(ref(db, 'schedule'), snap => {
schedule = snap.exists() ? snap.val() : {};
renderMain();
});
onValue(ref(db, 'log'), snap => {
if (snap.exists()) {
const raw = snap.val();
logEntries = Object.entries(raw).map(([k,v]) => ({ id: k, ...v })).sort((a,b) => b.ts - a.ts);
} else { logEntries = []; }
});
}
// ---- RENDER MAIN ----
function renderMain() {
const container = document.getElementById('schedule-container');
if (!settings.startDate || !settings.endDate) {
container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;">
<div style="font-size:48px;margin-bottom:16px">🐾</div>
<p style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;">Nog geen periode ingesteld</p>
<p style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;">Ga naar instellingen om een periode en namen in te stellen.</p>
</div>`;
document.getElementById('header-title').innerHTML = `<span class="title-line1">Balou's <span>schema</span></span><span class="title-line2" id="header-period"></span>`;
return;
}
const start = new Date(settings.startDate + 'T12:00:00');
const end = new Date(settings.endDate + 'T12:00:00');
document.getElementById('header-title').innerHTML = `<span class="title-line1">Balou's <span>schema</span></span><span class="title-line2">${formatDate(settings.startDate)} – ${formatDate(settings.endDate)}</span>`;
let html = '';
const cur = new Date(start);
while (cur <= end) {
const ds = dateStr(cur);
const isToday = ds === today();
const dow = getDayOfWeek(ds);
const dayData = schedule[ds] || {};
// Which tasks apply today?
const activeTasks = TASKS.filter(t => {
if (t.always) return true;
if (t.type === 'vuilbak') { const entries = settings.vuilbakDates.filter(x => (x.date || x) === ds); return entries.length > 0; }
return false;
});
const doneCount = activeTasks.filter(t => {
if (t.key !== 'vuilbak') return !!dayData[t.key];
const vd = dayData.vuilbak || {};
const dayEntries = settings.vuilbakDates.filter(x => (x.date || x) === ds);
return dayEntries.length > 0 && dayEntries.every((e, i) => vd[`${e.type || 'rest'}_${i}`]);
}).length;
const totalCount = activeTasks.length;
html += `<div class="day-card ${isToday ? 'today' : ''}" id="day-${ds}">
<div class="day-header">
<div class="day-date">${formatDateLong(ds)}</div>
${isToday ? '<span class="today-badge">Vandaag</span>' : ''}
<div class="day-progress">Gedaan: ${doneCount}/${totalCount}</div>
</div>
<div class="day-tasks">`;
const dotColors = { rest:'#6b7280', pmd:'#3b82f6', gft:'#22c55e', papier:'#ca8a04' };
// Opmerkingen bovenaan als er inhoud is
const rem = dayData.opmerkingen || '';
if (rem) {
html += `<div class="dag-sectie" style="background:rgba(45,106,79,0.06);border-left:3px solid var(--green-light);">
<div class="dag-sectie-label">📝 Opmerkingen</div>
<div class="remarks-readonly">${rem}</div>
</div>`;
}
SECTIES.forEach(sectie => {
const sectieTaken = activeTasks.filter(t => t.sectie === sectie.key);
if (sectieTaken.length === 0) return;
const rijClass = sectie.cols === 2 ? 'taak-rij-2' : sectie.cols === 1 ? 'taak-rij-1' : 'taak-rij-auto';
html += `<div class="dag-sectie ${sectie.key}">`;
if (!sectie.hideLabel) html += `<div class="dag-sectie-label">${sectie.label}</div>`;
html += `<div class="${rijClass}">`;
sectieTaken.forEach(task => {
if (task.type === 'vuilbak') {
const dayEntries = settings.vuilbakDates.filter(x => (x.date || x) === ds);
const vuilbakDayData = dayData.vuilbak || {};
const typeAfk = { rest:'Rest', pmd:'PMD', gft:'GFT', papier:'Paper' };
// Always render as grid of 4 (pad with empty if < 4)
const allTypes = ['rest','pmd','gft','papier'];
html += `<div class="vuilbak-rij">`;
allTypes.forEach(t => {
const entry = dayEntries.find(e => (e.type || 'rest') === t);
if (!entry) {
html += `<div class="vuilbak-leeg"></div>`;
return;
}
const idx = dayEntries.indexOf(entry);
const key = `${t}_${idx}`;
const done = vuilbakDayData[key];
const dotColor = dotColors[t] || '#6b7280';
html += `<button class="task-btn vuilbak-entry ${done ? 'vuilbak-done' : 'vuilbak-todo'}"
onclick="toggleVuilbakEntry('${ds}', '${key}', ${done ? 'true' : 'false'})">
<span class="vuilbak-bol" style="background:${dotColor};"></span>
${done
? `<span class="vuilbak-naam">✓ ${done}</span>`
: `<span class="vuilbak-type">${typeAfk[t] || t}</span>`}
</button>`;
});
html += `</div>`;
} else {
const val = dayData[task.key];
const isDone = !!val;
const colorClass = isDone ? `color-${getNameColor(val)}` : '';
html += `<button class="task-btn ${isDone ? 'done ' + colorClass : ''}"
onclick="openPopup('${ds}', '${task.key}', '${task.label}')">
<span class="taak-naam">${task.emoji} ${task.label}</span>
<span class="taak-waarde">${isDone ? '✓ ' + val : 'Te doen'}</span>
</button>`;
}
});
html += `</div></div>`;
});
html += `</div></div>`;
cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
}
container.innerHTML = html;
// Scroll to today
if (isToday) {
setTimeout(() => {
const el = document.getElementById(`day-${today()}`);
if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
}, 100);
}
}
function isToday(ds) { return ds === today(); }
// ---- POPUP ----
window.openPopup = function(dateStr, taskKey, taskLabel) {
pendingTask = { dateStr, taskKey };
document.getElementById('popup-task-label').textContent = taskLabel + ' — ' + formatDateLong(dateStr);
const list = document.getElementById('popup-names-list');
// If already done — offer to undo
const val = (schedule[dateStr] || {})[taskKey];
if (val) {
list.innerHTML = `<button class="popup-name-btn" style="background:#fee2e2;color:#dc2626;border-color:#fca5a5;"
onclick="undoTask()">↩️ Ongedaan maken (${val})</button>`;
